library_header.collections.description: Library header control: opens the library's collections page. A count follows it after a middle dot once known (Collections · 12), so keep it to one short word.

library_header.recommended.description: Library header control: opens the library's recommended page (the server's hubs for the library). One short word.

library_header.sort_filter.description: Library header control that opens the one menu holding the type to show, the sort order and the filters. The current sort follows it after a middle dot and a fold arrow ends it, so keep the label short.

library_header.filtered_of.description: Library header read-out shown only while a filter is on: how many titles match, of how many the library holds (312 of 1,284). Both numbers arrive already formatted for the language.

library_header.show.description: Heading of the first section of the Sort & Filter menu, over the list of what the library page shows (Films, Shows, Seasons, Episodes).

library_header.scan.description: Library header control, the row's last: asks the server to look for added and removed files in this library. Shown only on the account's own servers. Keep it short.

library_header.scan_requested.description: Replaces the Scan library label for a few seconds once the server has accepted the request. It says only that the server took it, not that the scan has finished.

library_header.scan_failed.description: Replaces the Scan library label for a few seconds when the server refused the scan request or did not answer.
